newsitem.title: USA: North Dakota fieldwork delayed by snow, rain.
newsitem.headline: North Dakota fieldwork delayed by snow, rain.

text.p: Rain and snow storms late in the week ended Sunday delayed all North Dakota fieldwork, according to the weekly state crop report.
Many producers in the west were kept from the fields virtually all week by wet conditions.
Sunflower harvest progress continued ahead of average, while corn for grain caught the average pace for the first time this year.
Sunflower harvesting advanced to 80 percent complete, versus 57 a week ago, 57 last year and the five-year average of 63 percent.
Corn for grain harvested 62 percent vs 27 w/a, 68 y/a, 62 avg.
Flaxseed harvested 97 percent vs 96 w/a, 99 y/a, 98 avg.
Potatoes dug 100 percent vs 98 w/a, 96 y/a, 99 avg.
Soybeans harvested 99 percent vs 92 w/a, 81 y/a, 92 avg.
Sugarbeets lifted 99 percent vs 97 w/a, 93 y/a, 96 avg.
Pasture and range condition was rated 36 pct good to excellent, versus 26 percent at that level last week.
